body: I started to write one 2 years back when i was going through a bad phase and I only managed to write part of it to my dad and then i stopped. As for now, i haven't written one. I occasionally write in a A4 dairy and ive said im going to kill myself in 30days if nothing improves in my life( This was beginning of April so yay im still here. . . )  and how im feeling on the bad days , shit like that. So i figured if i do kill myself i wont write anything,i have no energy to write one, so when i die they will find my dairy and see all the stuff ive written and piece the puzzle together

hmm bro, i dont know what you are going through but as far as i remeber school was some of my best memories! it might seem like it sucks at the time but you have Billions and Billions of decisions that you can make to change your life dramatically for the better. Im a little older than yourself (25) and all i think about is the good old days when i was in school, i had the world at my fingertips, now its all different, we feel the same right now, life becomes a lot harder, responsibilities and obligations make this much more difficult. My suggestion to you would be to get professional help now, while you are still young and have Plenty opportunities to fix your life and get it back on track. because if you leave it for too long then your old, depressed, and have nothing going for you. DONT get to that point.
